name: Jokyoushi o Kurau
source:
Tetsuya is an ordinary high school student in appearance. But, he gets secrets of female teachers and students by tapping and secret filming. And he has sex with them by extortion. One day, a new female teacher, Chigusa, comes to his class. "I wanna shag her...." He immediately makes a plan to get her....

[From ErogeShop]
